import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
for e in exposures:
    d = df.dropna(subset=[e,'recovery_score'])
    m = smf.ols(f'recovery_score ~ {e} + C(hospital)', data=d).fit()
    print(f"{e:14s} coef={m.params[e]:8.4f} se={m.bse[e]:7.4f} p={m.pvalues[e]:.4g} n={len(d)}")

import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
print(df.groupby('hospital')[['vitamin_d','recovery_score']].mean())
# within-hospital correlation
for h,g in df.groupby('hospital'):
    print(h, g['vitamin_d'].corr(g['recovery_score']), len(g))
# check vitamin_d distribution - maybe nonlinear
print(df['vitamin_d'].describe())
